title: A misspelt keyword
prompt: The word that starts a function is spelt wrong, so Godot does not know what this line means. Fix it so the robot prints "Online".
hints: Keywords like func, var and return must be spelt exactly.
The error points at the first line.

docs.name: The error panel
docs.what: Godot's message plus the line it happened on, counted from the top of your code.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
